description: Create and remove real Thunderbird account nodes for EAS accounts via XPCOM.

functions.name: createAccount
functions.description: Create a top-level Thunderbird account node for an EAS email address. Returns the account key string.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The EAS email address (used as display name and username).

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: The EAS server hostname (used as server hostname to keep accounts unique).

functions.name: removeAccount
functions.description: Remove a Thunderbird account node previously created by EAS, including its local mail files.

parameters.name: accountKey
parameters.description: The Thunderbird account key returned by createAccount.
